name: argus
description: Connect Codex to a scoped Argus instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped Argus tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to Argus through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so Argus Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Argus only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
